caption:
934MW of power purchase agreements: Amazon's four new PPAs in India, per DCD.

The headline: Amazon to invest $7bn into Indian renewable projects by 2030.

On the data centre side, our tracker lists 59 projects in India: 2,644 MW under construction and 8,171 MW announced, the second-largest announced pipeline after the United States at 17,943 MW.

PPA capacity is not data centre capacity, but it shows where power is being lined up ahead of the halls.

Sources: DCD, 17 Nov 2026 (headline and standfirst). Data: Coloprice pipeline tracker, 18 Nov 2026.
